title.zh: 【汇丰公布香港稳定币名称为「HSBC RedCoin」，计划分阶段推出】
title.en: 【汇丰公布香港稳定币名称为「HSBC RedCoin」，计划分阶段推出】

current_state.zh: HSBC named its upcoming Hong Kong stablecoin HSBC RedCoin and outlined a phased rollout starting with P2P transfers and merchant payments before expanding to corporate and institutional applications, citing a survey of over 1,000 local customers showing broad stablecoin awareness.
current_state.en: HSBC named its upcoming Hong Kong stablecoin HSBC RedCoin and outlined a phased rollout starting with P2P transfers and merchant payments before expanding to corporate and institutional applications, citing a survey of over 1,000 local customers showing broad stablecoin awareness.
